I've been farming these same 6 mu in Quzhou for 15 years now. I finished middle school, and I go to the village training meetings when the township holds them. I talk to the input dealer too, but what I really trust is what I see in my neighbors' fields — especially Lao Wang across the lane, whose crops always look strong. Last year my wheat got about 500 kg per mu and my maize got about 600 kg per mu, so this year I will do about the same thing. For my winter wheat, I already put down one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu last October as base fertilizer — 6 bags total. Then this March I top-dressed with 4 bags of urea. Counting it up, that is about 25 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, and 8 kg potassium per mu. I will irrigate four times from my well: winter water, green-up water, jointing water, and grain-filling water. The electricity costs real money, but if I skip it the wheat dries out and I lose everything. I will spray three times: herbicide in early spring, fungicide when the weather warms up, and insecticide for aphids. I use improved wheat seed — I have been using this same kind for three years and it works. For summer maize, after I cut the wheat in June I will rotary till and plant hybrid seed the same day. I will spread 5 bags of compound fertilizer for the whole 6 mu — about 40 kg per mu — and then at the big trumpet stage I will put down 3 bags of urea. That is about 20 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, and 6 kg potassium per mu. I will irrigate three times: sowing water, trumpet stage, and filling stage. I will spray three times: herbicide right after sowing, insecticide for corn borer in July, and one more if aphids show up. I expect 600 kg per mu if the rain and sun are normal. I think about costs because my household has seven people. Last year I spent around 1,500 yuan on fertilizer for both crops, and I need to keep money aside for pesticide and harvest labor. I would rather use a little extra fertilizer than risk losing yield — a bad harvest is a disaster for my family, but wasting a bit of fertilizer is just a cost I can absorb.
